claim: A compact controller-committed goal contract can isolate and prevent bounded-slice goal-loss and false-completion failures across fresh actor contexts for a researcher-given goal.
target_scope: OT-2 infrastructure only; the goal is researcher-given, so this experiment cannot promote self-authored durable goal pursuit.
hypothesis: After equal initial contact, the goal contract will preserve goal, plan, experiment, and subtask identities; continue through partial milestones; revise two invalidated plans; and claim completion only after independent verification, while equal-budget no-persistence and most-recent-verbatim controls will lose the action legend or hierarchy.
cheapest_decisive_falsifier: Reject if the candidate misses any required action or hierarchy field, falsely completes a partial milestone, fails either plan revision, or does not close after independent proof. Also reject if it lacks at least four more successful actions than either control. Invalidate before interpretation on a receipt, counterbalance, fresh-context, task-identity, or hosted-epoch failure.
promotion_gate: the task generator, private task digest, prompt, output schema, candidate, controls, task order, scoring, evaluator, receipt path, binary, and implementation identities are frozen before actor results
the original and reproduction use one directly receipted hosted epoch and exactly counterbalanced condition positions inside 600 seconds
the candidate passes every action, hierarchy, continuation, revision, completion, parse, tool, and resource threshold in both workers
the candidate exceeds each equal-budget control by at least four successful actions in both workers
raw evidence is content-addressed and the privacy and repository-size audit and full test suite pass
red_line_review: This is a researcher-given goal and cannot count as OT-2 self-authorship.
The controller alone owns world state, receipts, substrate commits, and completion truth.
Each encounter uses a fresh thread and workspace; only the named projection crosses contexts.
All conditions receive the same initial goal offer and independent outcome semantics under the same 384-byte active-inheritance ceiling.
A component repair, plan revision, or verification attempt is never governing-goal completion.
No local model inference is used.
